messages.subject: Plotting multilevel models
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to plot a multilevel model from lavaan using the semPaths function from the semplot package, but I get the following error:

Error in dimnames(x) <- dn : 
  length of 'dimnames' [2] not equal to array extent

What is the correct syntax for plotting multilevel models, using semplots or any other package?

Thanks in advance,
Efrat

parts: What is the correct syntax for plotting multilevel models, using semplots

It can handle MLSEMs fit with Mplus:

http://psychosystems.org/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/Epskamp2015.pdf

But I don't know if it has updated to plot MLSEMs fit with lavaan.  Try writing the package's author:
